newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire discussing Shui Wing financing.
newsitem.headline: Swire discussing Shui Wing financing.

text.p: Swire Pacific Ltd said on Thursday it was discussing financing for the redevelopment of the former Shui Wing steel mill in Hong Kong's Tseung Kwan O but added there was no "pressing urgency" to raise funds.
"That is something that is under discussion," Peter Johansen, group finance director, told Reuters.
"There is no pressing urgency in that we have made payments already out of our existing resources and this project is a five-year project," he added.

Swire Pacific's Swire Properties Ltd and Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd's New Town Properties Ltd unit have acquired the rights to develop the former mill site. The total project cost is estimated to be in excess of HK$25 billion.
Bankers said on Wednesday they would be invited to bid this week for a mandate to arrange a HK$7-8 billion financing for the joint project.
